purpose: Real-provider task acceptance; synthetic data, disposable database, no external writes.
method: Six workflows, two repetitions each. Actual conversation/tool/domain loop. Full catalog, local operations allowlist. Synthetic injected memory plus canonical lexical lookup. UI acknowledgements simulated. Twelve-round/thirty-tool per-turn limits, 8192 generated-token cap for both models.
compatibility: Luna low reasoning was rejected by Chat Completions with function tools. Final Luna runs use none. Gemini uses low. Reasoning-enabled Luna through Responses was not tested.
harness_corrections: Diagnostic runs excluded: Luna incompatible reasoning setting, and a fixture that blocked legitimate memory_search. Final dataset seeds canonical synthetic memory and permits lexical lookup. Final rerun included both models and all cases.
cost_note: Uncached-rate equivalent is only a normalized comparison: it ignores cache discounts and cache-write premiums, and is not an invoice or production cost ledger. Failed diagnostic requests and preliminary checks are excluded.
